children: Ryanair said it signed an agreement with the Swedish Transport Workers' Union on wages and terms of employment for its cabin crew at the Arlanda base.
The Dublin-based budget airline on Thursday said that under the agreement working conditions--including salary, working hours and pensions--are now regulated and secured.
"This agreement will support Ryanair's $800 million investment in Sweden and helps secure well-paid, highly skilled aviation employment," the airline said.
